items.title: GB LG polls: Elections for municipal corporation seats in Chilas, Skardu, Gilgit to be held on Dec 5
items.description:
GILGIT: Gilgit-Baltistan Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Raja Shahbaz Khan on Thursday announced a revised schedule for local body elections in the region, according to which the polling for municipal corporation seats in the towns of Chilas, Skardu and Gilgit has been fixed for Dec 5.
Local government (LG) polls in GB — announced last year after a gap of more than two decades — were originally set to take place on Feb 14, 2026. However, they have since been postponed repeatedly due to various factors, the most recent being harsh weather conditions and amendments to the Local Government Act.

items.description:

The IMF said Japan would remain the fourth-largest country by nominal gross domestic product this year, but in 2027 India is set to take its place, with a GDP reaching $4.52 trillion.

items.title: What is the 'hospital of the popes' where Pope Leo is recovering from surgery?
items.description:
Rome’s Gemelli Hospital, where Pope Leo is recovering after surgery for lung cancer, is known as the “hospital of the popes”.
The hospital, with a suite especially for popes, has become the preferred medical facility for modern pontiffs since the time of Pope John Paul II.
What is the Gemelli?
Located some five kilometres from the Vatican City, the Gemelli hospital offers every major medical speciality under one roof. It also serves as the teaching hospital of the Catholic University of the Sacred Heart and has more than 1,600 beds.
